title: AI and Smart Data for Cultural Heritage
bookshelves: Category: Reference, Information and Interdisciplinary subjects
summary: This volume explores the transformation of Digital Humanities (DH) research by AI and smart data, offering global perspectives on innovative methodologies and practices in cultural heritage, with contributions from Asia, Europe, North America, and South America. Moving from big data to smart data and into the AI era, DH researchers continue to develop new concepts, methodologies, and practices. Smart data, which provides insights from trusted, contextualised, cognitive, predictive, and consumable data at any scale, will continue to hold significant value in our field with AI providing additional support. Addressing both approach and practice, this volume presents the latest advancements and trends in AI and smart data for cultural heritage in DH. It also makes a valuable contribution to critical theories, methods, and practices for leveraging these technologies in cultural heritage. This book will be an essential reference for DH researchers, cultural heritage professionals, and AI practitioners working at the intersection of technology and humanities scholarship.
